create_eval_result: create an EvalResult dataclass instance with task, dataset, and metric fields for model evaluation reporting
build_model_card_data: build a ModelCardData instance with model name, eval results, license, and tags for Hugging Face model cards
build_dataset_card_data: build a DatasetCardData instance with language, license, and task categories for Hugging Face dataset cards
build_space_card_data: build a SpaceCardData instance with title, sdk, and license for Hugging Face Spaces configuration
convert_eval_results_to_model_index: convert a list of EvalResult objects into a model-index dict compatible with Hugging Face Hub format
